title: Planasa - Blueberry Blue Manila
summary: Planasa's variety page for Blue Manila gives 3,300 to 4,000 g per plant, 4 g per fruit and 14 degrees Brix. No trial site, season, replication or measurement method is stated.
why_it_matters: One half of an internal inconsistency: this page and Planasa's own data sheet for the same cultivar give different soluble solids figures and express yield in non-comparable units. Where an owner cannot agree with itself, an averaged or arbitrary figure would be worse than recording the disagreement.

testing.rationale: Would need independent measurement to be usable.
